title: Palimpsity - Living Layers
description: Choose how to play: grow a sandbox city from 600 EUR, create freely with unlimited construction funds and every building unlocked, or take on River Pact and its drought. Stack modular buildings up to four floors and reshape their uses and rooftops. Automatically produced by LOB7 Enhancement, with Kimi implementation and Nilo integration and review.
controls: Choose Sandbox, God mode or River Pact at startup. First Neighbourhood remains available as a separate timed challenge.
The current mode menu opens a new-game selector. Replacing the city requires confirmation; returning keeps the current city paused.
Sandbox starts with 600 EUR, normal income, costs and unlocks, with no deadline or forced ending.
God mode: all buildings and upgrades available, free construction and transformations, no defeat. Food, water and services are still simulated.
Click: build or inspect. Drag: rotate. Right-drag: pan. Scroll: zoom. R: rotate a building. Escape: cancel. Space: pause or resume.
Arrow keys and Enter: choose a tile and build or inspect. English / Français: switch language without restarting.
River Pact: choose a charter after Act I, then supply both districts through the drought on turns 120-149. Advance 5 turns runs real turns and pauses at choices or results.
First Neighbourhood: 24 residents, 8 healthy turns, deadline 120. Only this challenge records a best time.
Inspect a building to preview and confirm floors, roofs or conversions. Up to four floors; all effects shown before confirmation.
Hiding the tab pauses the game; resume manually. River quays require two districts on the same water basin; rotate their water-facing side with R.
